# @apexdevtools/apex-log-parser

> TypeScript library for parsing Salesforce Apex debug logs into structured, navigable event trees. Zero dependencies, ESM-only.

This library takes raw Salesforce Apex debug log text and produces a typed tree of parsed events. It supports 200+ event types, computes execution timing (self and total duration in nanoseconds), tracks governor limits with per-namespace snapshots, and counts SOQL/DML/SOSL rows aggregated up the call tree.

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { parse } from '@apexdevtools/apex-log-parser';

const log = parse(debugLogText);

for (const event of log.children) {
  console.log(event.type, event.text, event.duration.total);
}
```

## Key APIs

- `parse(logData: string): ApexLog` — Parse raw log text into an event tree
- `ApexLogParser` class — Stateful parser exposing `governorLimits`, `logIssues`, `namespaces`
- `LogEvent` — Base class for all events with `type`, `text`, `timestamp`, `duration`, `children`, `parent`, `namespace`, `debugCategory`, `debugLevel`
- Event subclasses: `MethodEntryLine`, `SOQLExecuteBeginLine`, `DMLBeginLine`, `CodeUnitStartedLine`, `FlowStartInterviewsBeginLine`, `CalloutRequestLine`, `ExceptionThrownLine`, etc.
- `getLogEventClass(type)` — Look up event class by type string
- Constants: `DEBUG_CATEGORY`, `LOG_CATEGORY`, `LOG_LEVEL`

## Governor Limits

```typescript
const parser = new ApexLogParser();
parser.parse(logText);
parser.governorLimits.cpuTime;      // { used, limit }
parser.governorLimits.soqlQueries;  // { used, limit }
parser.governorLimits.dmlStatements; // { used, limit }
```

## Event Database

A bundled JSON database of 299 Salesforce debug log event types is available:

```typescript
import events from '@apexdevtools/apex-log-parser/data/events.json' with { type: 'json' };
```
